name: happyhorse-1.0-r2v
description: HappyHorse 1.0 R2V is a reference-guided video generation model that supports character, object, and scene references. With up to seven reference images and optional video input, it can generate new videos while maintaining consistent identity, style, and visual attributes across scenes. The model is designed for IP extension, character-driven storytelling, sequel creation, brand-consistent video production, and creative workflows that require strong visual consistency.
zhDescription: happyhorse-1.0-r2v 是支持角色、道具、场景参考的创意视频生成模型，可基于最多 7 张参考图及可选视频输入生成新视频，并保持角色外观、场景风格和视觉属性的一致性。模型适合角色 IP 延展、作品续集、多场景统一、品牌视觉一致性内容生产，以及需要跨镜头、跨场景保持高度一致性的创意视频工作流。
longDescription: HappyHorse 1.0 R2V is a reference-guided video generation model that supports character, object, and scene references. With up to seven reference images and optional video input, it can generate new videos while maintaining consistent identity, style, and visual attributes across scenes. The model is designed for IP extension, character-driven storytelling, sequel creation, brand-consistent video production, and creative workflows that require strong visual consistency.
zhLongDescription: happyhorse-1.0-r2v 是支持角色、道具、场景参考的创意视频生成模型，可基于最多 7 张参考图及可选视频输入生成新视频，并保持角色外观、场景风格和视觉属性的一致性。模型适合角色 IP 延展、作品续集、多场景统一、品牌视觉一致性内容生产，以及需要跨镜头、跨场景保持高度一致性的创意视频工作流。
